# YDBRD-9623 测试概要设计

IR链接：    [YDBRD-9623](https://jira.yasdb.com/browse/YDBRD-9623?src=confmacro)    -  视图支持更新能力  待RMT评审

## 1. 需求概述

**场景**  ：视图支持更新能力，包括增删改

**支持的部署形态**  ：单机（行表），集群

## 2. 功能点

支持WITH { READ ONLY| CHECK OPTION }功能

## 3. 规格约束

只支持单表识别更新

## 4. 主要应用场景

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE EDITIONABLE VIEW "DAS"."HRMS_VIEWTDPT" ("DPTID", "DPTPARNT", "DPTPRCNO", "DPTNO", "DPTNAME", "DPTISACTIVE", "DPTTYPEID", "DPTADD", "DPTPHONE", "DPTMNGR", "DPTCNTCT", "DPTCRTDBY", "DPTCRTDDAY", "DPTISSELECT", "DPTHOUSETYPE", "DPTHOUSEAREA", "DPTHOUSECOST", "DPTHOUSEWATERVALUE", "DPTHOUSEELECTVALUE", "DPTHOUSEGASVALUE", "DPTHOUSEISBILL", "PDPTNO", "CARDTYPEID") AS SELECT "DPTID","DPTPARNT","DPTPRCNO","DPTNO","DPTNAME","DPTISACTIVE","DPTTYPEID","DPTADD","DPTPHONE","DPTMNGR","DPTCNTCT","DPTCRTDBY","DPTCRTDDAY","DPTISSELECT","DPTHOUSETYPE","DPTHOUSEAREA","DPTHOUSECOST","DPTHOUSEWATERVALUE","DPTHOUSEELECTVALUE","DPTHOUSEGASVALUE","DPTHOUSEISBILL","PDPTNO","CARDTYPEID"    
  FROM Hrms_Dpt    
  WHERE DptTypeID = 2    
  WITH CHECK OPTION
